name: Prompt Agents — static gateway
summary: Foundry Prompt Agent (PromptAgentDefinition) created with model routed through the static APIM AI Gateway connection.
description: Creates an agent version with PromptAgentDefinition(model='{static-gateway-connection}/{deployment}') and invokes it via the Responses API using extra_body.agent_reference. Verifies that BYOM models routed through a static (single backend) APIM connection work end-to-end as a v2 agent.
notes: Requires AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_STATIC to point at an ApiManagement connection on the Foundry project.
